name: logo
label: Logo
inline_help_text: The logo shown in the site header. Falls back to the logo in your website settings.

name: logo_alt_text
label: Logo alt text
inline_help_text: Describes the logo for screen readers, usually the company name. Falls back to the alt text set in your website settings.

name: logo_link
label: Logo link
inline_help_text: Where the logo links to. Falls back to the homepage.

name: menu
label: Navigation menu
inline_help_text: Select the advanced menu to show in the main navigation. Menus are managed under Settings > Website > Navigation.

name: show_cta
label: Show header button
inline_help_text: Show a call-to-action button to the right of the navigation.

name: cta_text
label: Button text
inline_help_text: The button label, for example "Get in touch".

name: cta_link
label: Button link
inline_help_text: Where the button goes. The button is hidden until both this and the button text are set.
